##### Project general facts

Arabian Hills Estate presents a master‑planned community that marries expansive living spaces with a verdant backdrop. The development offers four exclusive plot categories, ranging from elegant villa plots to grand estate plots that emphasize spaciousness and distinction. A thoughtful layout integrates lush greenery and the soothing blues of nature to create an environment where ambition and elegance converge.  

Residents can dive into swimmable lagoons, stroll along pristine beaches, or unwind at tranquil pools and a dedicated aqua park with a lounge pool. Equestrian enthusiasts benefit from world‑class stables, paddocks, riding arenas and jumping arenas, while athletes enjoy padel courts, tennis courts, ball courts, soccer fields and a mini‑golf course. Additional assets include Zen gardens, picnic areas, a dog park and a nature trail that weave seamlessly through the community’s green spaces.  

The community is further enriched by an exceptional collection of services and experiences designed to support daily life with elegance and ease. The development also features a hotel resort and spa, a four-screen cinema, concert venues, adventure parks, and a dedicated child care facility, while community services including medical centres, police and fire stations, banking facilities, post offices, and shuttle bus services ensure that every need is anticipated and every convenience is always close at hand.

##### Location description and benefits

Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, combines a stable market with advanced infrastructure and a luxurious lifestyle that ranks among the world’s safest places to reside. The emirate delivers top‑notch healthcare and education while maintaining a minimal‑tax economy that attracts global talent. The UAE Golden Visa adds long‑term residency benefits, making the city a rewarding home for discerning individuals.  

Exceptional connectivity links the city to international airports, Academic City and the region’s most prestigious universities within comfortable reach. Nearby premier retail destinations such as Dubai Mall and City Walk sit alongside renowned hospitals, pristine beaches and vibrant cultural and commercial hubs. This blend of accessibility and leisure ensures that business, study and recreation remain perfectly balanced.  

Adventurous residents can experience skydiving, hot‑air ballooning, wildlife observation and desert exploration within a short drive. Ongoing development, backed by a publicly listed parent company and a seasoned development management partner, signals robust long‑term potential for owners and investors. The area thus offers the serenity of a thoughtfully planned community alongside the dynamic energy of one of the world’s most progressive cities.
